description: Record that the household, or one member, likes or dislikes an ingredient, a dish, a category, a texture or a way of cooking. Allergies and intolerances are not likes: Bryti keeps them in the app.

memberName.description: Member the preference belongs to; omit for the whole household.

subject.description: The food, ingredient, or dish. For subjectType Taste prefer the canonical lowercase English keys: sweet, salty, sour, bitter, umami, spicy, rich, fresh.

name: add_food_preference
title: Note a like or dislike
